notes: Nine distinct interaction episodes are visible. The two upper double-door cabinet manipulations are treated as one localized episode per cabinet because their paired doors are operated within the same short manipulation burst, with no clear disengagement between individual leaves.
scene_description: A user surveys a kitchen and then sequentially opens and closes a refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, pantry and upper cabinets, followed by lids on two countertop cookers and the basket of an air fryer.
